name: cavemio-magnifying-dock
title: Magnifying dock
description: A dock that makes room for the tool you reach for, then opens it in place.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The tools form a toolbar: one tab stop, Left and Right (and Home, End) move between enabled tools, and keyboard focus magnifies like the pointer.
- Tools with content are disclosure buttons (aria-expanded, aria-controls) for a labelled panel region that follows them in the tab order; tools without content are toggle buttons.
- Touch skips the lens and opens tools directly. Reduced motion removes the lens and every eased move; states change in place.
- One frame loop eases the lens, pad, label and tray, writes only transforms and the tray’s size, and stops when everything settles, so a resting dock costs nothing.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · Each tool: id, label, icon, and optionally content (what it opens into), title (the panel heading, defaults to label), badge (a count) and disabled.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: – · Controlled selected tool or the initial one. Defaults to the first enabled tool.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Called when a different tool is chosen.

props.name: open / defaultOpen
props.description: – · Whether the selected tool’s panel is open. Tools without content never open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: – · Called when the panel opens or folds away.

props.name: size
props.description: 40 · Rest size of a tool in pixels, 32–56.

props.name: magnification
props.description: 1.6 · Peak scale under the pointer, 1–2. It eases down to 1.22 while a panel is open so tools stay clear of it.

props.name: panelWidth
props.description: 340 · Width of the open panel; it never exceeds the space available.

props.name: label
props.description: Tools · Accessible name for the toolbar.

useCases.title: Floating tool trays
useCases.description: A tray of notes, search and settings that opens each tool in place.

useCases.title: Portfolio and personal sites
useCases.description: Navigation between sections that feels like a toolbar.

useCases.title: Product demo pages
useCases.description: A dock of features where each one opens a small preview.

useCases.title: Admin quick actions
useCases.description: The handful of tools people reach for all day, one click away.

features.title: Icons swell near the pointer
features.description: Tools close to the pointer scale up and the row parts around them. Distances use fixed rest positions, so the target never slides away.

features.title: One label that follows
features.description: A single label follows the nearest tool, and its letters morph when the tool changes.

features.title: The tray becomes the panel
features.description: A tool with content grows the tray up into its panel. Switching tools slides the new panel in from the side you moved toward.

features.title: Badges that roll
features.description: A count on a tool rolls when it changes and folds away at zero.

features.title: Keyboard like a toolbar
features.description: One tab stop, arrow keys, Home and End. Keyboard focus magnifies like the pointer.

features.title: Light on the page
features.description: One frame loop writes only transforms and sleeps when nothing moves. Touch skips the lens and opens tools directly.

states.title: lens
states.description: Tools within 2.4 tool-widths of the pointer scale up on a cosine falloff and the row parts around them; the tray widens to fit. Distances use fixed rest positions, so growth never moves the target under the pointer.

states.title: label
states.description: One label follows the nearest tool, lifting above its current height; when the tool changes, its words morph letter by letter.

states.title: select
states.description: The pad glides to the chosen tool and keeps riding its magnification as you sweep.

states.title: open
states.description: A tool with content grows the tray up into its panel: width, height and corners ease together, the title morphs, and the content fades in. Switching tools slides the new panel in from the side you moved toward while its height eases.

states.title: close
states.description: Choosing the open tool again, Escape or a click outside folds the panel back into the tray. Escape returns focus to the tool.

states.title: badge
states.description: A count on a tool rolls when it changes and folds away at zero.
